_comment: THE DELIVERY BOARD (runner_board, delivery_board:true) is a SEPARATE mechanical prop, browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), distinct from THE REQUEST BOARD's own board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right one.

entities._comment: talk_pool fires her 'First approach' bark (board-copy.md sec.3) before the real conversation graph (vess_counter.json) on the first talk of a waking.
entities.observe: A teenage Drake, wiry, a strap-scarred satchel worn even behind the counter -- she never fully sat down, she just stopped moving for a second. Slate-grey scales, a sweat-band she does not need indoors and wears anyway.
talk_pool: Runner's Guild! Board's live. Take a slip, show me, go. It's yours until it's theirs — sleep on a run, you carry the shame instead.

entities._comment: browse-only (WIGame._interact_delivery_board), the delivery-loop's twin of THE REQUEST BOARD (guild_board), same header/second_visit/footer shape, distinct delivery_board:true flag so interact()'s prop dispatch routes to the right board.
entities.toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD. Legs and ledgers. Gold by distance, paid on the mark, same-waking terms. Slips at the counter.
entities.second_visit_toast: THE DELIVERY BOARD. Your slip's still logged at the counter. Legs and ledgers don't care how it's going either.
entities.observe: Couriers are made, not hired. Start with the market run. — the counter
A Gnoll runner, propped against the wall by the stool, legs out, boots still laced. Not asleep. Not far from it.
talk_pool: Floodplains double, both legs mud. Wake me for a fire or a Courier.
